marks.assessment:
## Reading the name

VENQORI reads as a coined whole word for the consumer water-quality app, its software services and attached online training. The profile identifies Japan and Korea as the launch markets. The plan supplies only Latin VENQORI and VENKORI. No intended Japanese or Korean version, confirmed house-mark presentation or earlier client use is supplied.

## Japan and Korea

**Low for Classes 9, 42 and 41 in Japan and Korea, on the held Latin-name evidence.** The evidence does not establish a material objection to the requested launch.

- Japan's live Ｖｅｎｋｕｒｉ registration belongs to YIWU TENGDING UMBRELLA CO., LTD. The mark uses full-width Latin letters, with BENKURI recorded as its transliteration. Its full goods wording includes batteries, cameras, projection equipment, earphones, plugs and surveillance equipment with monitors. These goods differ from the requested downloadable app, software service and attached training. Selling sensors or surveillance hardware is outside the request. Similar pronunciation does not itself establish related trade, and the held material does not establish related software sales in Japan. The Japanese バンバンカラ paper registration is cancelled and adds no live objection on its held status.
- Korea's returned K-VANKorea PASSENGER TRANSPORTATION EXPERT filing is cancelled. Its goods include mobile apps, data processing and Internet-of-Things software, but the whole composite name differs. The returned 주식회사 스타밴코리아 registration is expired and covers cash registers, card terminals and related payment equipment. Neither record establishes a live register objection on its held status. Those statuses do not decide whether use continues or whether unregistered rights remain. This is a bounded conclusion about the returned records, not a general absence of Korean rights.

The web and app-store payload provides listing titles and links, with little information about products, customers or territorial reach. It does not establish a competing water-quality offering under the material similar names in either launch market. No separate class conclusion is supported for the attached training or software service.

## Overseas cards and their limits

The overseas cards retain their comparisons of similar names and relevant goods in the offices shown. They do not supply the missing link to Japan or Korea.

- VINCARA's UK registration covers unrestricted software in Class 9. VENCORA's UK registration and EU application include general software development and training. VINCORA's EU registration includes IT services, testing and science training. Those terms support the Moderate cards in those territories, without establishing protection in either launch market.
- The Argentine VINKARA, Swiss vencura, New Zealand VENKARO and Indian Vincora records also retain their broader software, data or training concerns in their respective territories. The remaining national records likewise establish only the rights or applications held in their named offices.
- VENCORE's held international designation is the United States only. VONCORE's held international designations are AT, DE, ES, FR, GB, IT, LI, SG and BX. Neither international record extends to Japan or Korea.

The held owner checks do not establish relevant trade in Japan or Korea. Legado IT's public software business is not verified as the Argentine holders. The Swiss insurance-purpose material and Vontobel's financial-business material do not establish a competing local water-quality offering. The owner questions name VENQORI although the held marks differ, so their answers support only the business facts they actually contain.

VENQORI's launch rating is below the Moderate VINCARA, VENCORA and VINCORA cards because those cards concern overseas rights without an evidenced launch-market connection. The same territorial limit applies to the other overseas cards. Their broad goods are preserved rather than narrowed by assumptions about current trade. Different vowels and endings remain relevant to the whole-name comparison in those territories. Their enforcement appetite remains unresolved.

## Scope still open

The inherited register questions covered multiple offices, including Japan and Korea. Their literal zeroes and returned sound-alike list do not establish every pronunciation, root or local-script equivalent. The Korean native-script result is a returned candidate, not a search for an intended Korean version of VENQORI. No Japanese or Korean version of the proposed name has been assessed. Clarivate's transliteration indexing does not establish native-character exclusivity.

VINKORY's German goods wording remains absent from its full held record. Its relevance in Germany remains unresolved, and it supplies no demonstrated Japan/Korea connection. No evident famous-property echo emerges from the supplied name or results. No dedicated meaning or sensitivity search is recorded, so local-language connotations remain unassessed.
